James — attaching a redline from our side and inline suggestions below. I tried to keep to plain English and avoid shifting operational control. Key points we propose:

1) Narrow third-party IP indemnity: Redwood will defend and indemnify Customer for third-party claims alleging infringement by the Service as delivered (not including Customer Data, prompts, or customer modifications). We add an explicit exclusion for Open Source dependencies to the extent governed by their own licenses.

2) Defense control: Redwood will retain primary defense control but will not settle in a way that admits fault without Customer's written consent for claims that could materially affect Customer. We add standard cooperation obligations and notice timing (30 days).

3) Liability cap for indemnity remedies: Limited to the Order Form fees paid in the 12 months preceding the claim, with a carve for IP infringement where a higher cap (e.g., 2x) may apply — we propose 2x TCV but will accept alternate commercial parameters.

4) Customer data / fine-tuning carveout: If Customer provides an attestation and the training dataset is demonstrably isolated, Redwood will accept the carveout for that corpus only.

I attached RW_Proposed_Indemnity_Text_v2.docx (tracked changes) and a short explainer. Please review and tell us which items are blockers for Neurolytics. If we agree on the clause language, we can merge and send a clean PDF for signature.
